name: latham
description: Independent Windows voice assistant — reviewed many-site search and navigation preview

scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && node scripts/build-native-fixture.mjs && npm run setup:electron && powershell.exe -NoProfile -File scripts/generate-visual-fixtures.ps1 && playwright test
scripts.evaluate: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.test:detectors: node scripts/build-host.mjs && powershell.exe -NoProfile -File scripts/generate-detector-fixtures.ps1 && node scripts/evaluate-detectors.mjs
scripts.test:visual: npm run build && powershell.exe -NoProfile -File scripts/generate-visual-fixtures.ps1 && playwright test --project=chrome-and-fixture --no-deps --grep visual
